dialogues.speaker: Fengyun
dialogues.text: Alright, we still have enough canned, dried, and frozen provisions. But seeing as we're near the coast, we might as well try to get some more fresh food...

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: Me? No, no, no. I look after the ship's stores and supplies. The cook's busy below deck.

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: It's just too bad that all we have to hand is canned food and dried or frozen supplies. Otherwise, I'd have him whip you up a feast!

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: I heard that back in the day, sailors had to stick to a strict routine for their meals — once you left port, you'd eat the perishables first, then ration the rest day by day...

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: ...Until all you had left were biscuits and bread so stale, it might as well be bricks. Now, that's rough...

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: The preservation techniques we have these days are so much better! Our meals might not count as fine dining, but at least everything's reasonably fresh and nutritious.

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: Switching out Cryo potions and Mist Flowers is a breeze compared to cutting the rotten bits off perishable food, at any rate.

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: You know, back then, I didn't understand why the Captain was always sending people ashore to ask about the latest tech or spending huge sums of Mora to have the latest contraptions hauled aboard...

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: But now, I totally get it. I'll never doubt her judgment again!

choices.text: How do you have the strength to sail the seas without proper meals?
I'll leave you to it, then. Bye.

response.speaker: Fengyun
response.text: Alright... Hit me up beforehand the next time you drop by for a meal!
